title: Atelier
description: A high-contrast magazine: bone white and true black, very large Bodoni italics, hairlines and one oxblood accent.

tokens.FOOTER_BLURB: Published from a small studio, in no hurry.
tokens.HOME_HEADLINE: The quiet luxury of doing one thing properly
tokens.HOME_LEDE: Essays on objects, habits and the long way round.
tokens.ABOUT_BLURB: Atelier is a journal about the things worth keeping and the habits worth the effort. It is written by one editor and published when a piece is finished.
